properties.name:
The v0.43.0 version bump, and nothing else. The design meaning of a cut lives in the Release and its epoch, not in a version string, so the design holds.

ACCEPTED BEFORE THE MANIFEST FREEZE, DELIBERATELY: `release_includes_all` records each artifact's CURRENT checksum as shipped, so accepting afterwards would leave the release recording that it shipped the pre-bump file. Doing it in this order is one step; the other order is a gate failure and a second export, budgeted on every cut before someone wrote down which way round it goes.
